title: Sherpa-UI workflow definition
description: One workflow, as JSON: its nodes, their values, and the routes between their sockets. A node's data comes in on its header, of any type, and leaves from its Rows row ("node/rows"); where it forks, its header sends True and "node/#false" False. What each node IS comes from its kind. checkWorkflow() reads it; readWorkflow() reads a v1 as one. docs/history/plan-713-node-model.md

id.description: The workflow's id: its row in the store, and its draft, are filed under it.

label.description: Its name, as a reader sees it.

$comment: FROZEN by plan 934: saved before a graph link was a Connection. Read once into workflow.v3.json.

route.description: Joins an output socket to any input socket. NODE_KINDS says each socket's type: an input reads what it needs of what comes, and one of another type reads null, and its node warns (TODO 770). A node's data comes in on its header, which takes any, and leaves from its Rows row ("node/rows"), which only sends; where it forks, its header sends True and "node/#false" False. An input takes one route, unless it takes many.

tie.description: A zip tie: a place on the plane, and the routes it funnels through it in order, top to bottom, a small gap between each. It changes no data: a runner ignores it. Its x stays between the nodes its shortest tied route joins.
